response.rationale: Reach z-score of 5.0 is far beyond noise thresholds (~2-3), indicating a genuine deviation. CPM z-score of 0.0 means prices/auction pressure were flat, ruling out a price or competition shift and pointing to a pure demand/volume surge. Own-action confound flag is false, so this is unlikely to be the harness's own prior bid/budget change landing in the data. The pattern (reach surge with unchanged CPM, no confound) is most consistent with a real exogenous demand shift worth reacting to, e.g., raising budget to capture the extra volume at current cost efficiency.
